Implement task R5 from tasks.toml: Vendor Plotly asset

Fetch plotly.min.js and pin its SHA-256 alongside htmx. The charts page degrades to a table without it, so this is not a blocker.

Notes recorded on this task in tasks.toml -- read these first: they may be feedback from a prior review that this run must address, not just background context.
  Status was stale at the 2026-08-04 review: static/vendor/plotly.min.js (4.5MB) and htmx.min.js are already present, fetched by an unrecorded run of vendor_assets.sh. The remaining work is therefore the checksum pin only, which is the whole point of the task - 4.5MB of unverified third-party JS is exactly what U8/R5 exist to prevent. vendor_assets.sh has no PLOTLY_SHA256 variable at all; add one alongside HTMX_SHA256.

Exit criteria (every one must pass before you stop):
  - plotly vendored and checksum pinned
  - charts page renders curves in a browser

Constraints:
  - Touch only these paths: scripts/vendor_assets.sh
  - Work on branch task/R5-vendor-plotly-asset; create it from the current HEAD if absent.
  - Verify with: ./scripts/test
  - Then run: python3 scripts/backlog.py  (must exit 0)
  - When the exit criteria pass, set the status of this task to review in tasks.toml. Never set it to done -- only CI and a human reviewer do that.
  - Follow CLAUDE.md. Minimal diffs, no speculative refactors, no changes outside the paths above.
